title: 引子第001章 半路被救
content_zh:
神丐下山最新章节_引子第1页_神丐下山探界者_热点小说网
在一座豪华庄园里，一栋豪华的别墅内。正上演着被蒙面人围杀的一对母子……
“军儿……军儿……以后要听水叔的话。阿水，快带军儿走，走的越远越好！有机会就去找他父亲。”
“小姐，放心，我一定把小少爷保护好。”仆人秦雨水左手抱着三岁的孩子秦延军，右手拿着一柄剑，嘴上快速的说道。
“爸爸……爸爸……你在哪里？快来救救妈妈，啊……啊……”
小孩子的哭喊声，引来了杀手的注意，秦雨水抱着孩子只能向着庄园外冲去，后面杀手紧追不舍……
作为当家主母的柳嫣然，为了保护唯一的儿子，命令仆人秦雨水将他带走。
自己被几个蒙面人围攻，心中有些怨恨：“飞雄，你去了哪里？儿子都快要被人杀了，你还不回来？”
“告诉我，你们究竟是什么人？为什么要来刺杀我们娘俩？”
“哈哈哈，放心好了，你的男人回不来了。”
“也许，这个时候已经不在人世，你还是不要想的太好，以免更绝望。”蒙面人趾高气扬的说着。
此时，柳嫣然产生了绝望，心中也发了狠。
“既然这样，你们就去死吧！天杀的，我要让你们碎尸万段。”
一时之间，柳嫣然不知道从哪里拿了一柄剑，左冲右杀，剑影翻飞，蒙面人感觉到了压力。
“兄弟们，金主说了，这个人必须死，还有那个逃走的孩子，都不要留手了，加把劲，不然一会儿就有人来了，完不成任务，回去就要受罚。”
“哈哈哈哈，兄弟们，加油，争取早点完工。”
蒙面人甚是猖狂，除了追出去的四五个蒙面人之外，别墅内还有六七人大笑着。
柳嫣然愤怒到了极点，提起手中的长剑，愤怒的飞舞着斩向蒙面人。
可是，终究只是一个带着孩子的母亲，平时疏于修炼，在六七个人的攻击下，很快，便处于下风。
最后，再斩杀了两人，终于体力不支，半跪在地，一手杵着剑。

“臭女人，竟然杀了我们两个人，今天你必须死。否则，怎么给他们交代？”
“老大，还是快点吧！时间长了会有意外发生。”
半跪在地的柳嫣然，只知自己今天可能活不成了，开口问道。
“几位？你们蒙着面，这些我不过问。看在我即将死去的份上，让我死一个明白，告诉我幕后指使是谁？”
“呵呵！你还想当一个明白鬼？告诉你可以，但是我说完以后你不能再抵抗。”
柳嫣然把剑丢在了自己面前，表现出自己的‘诚心’！
几个蒙面人看见柳嫣然把剑丢在了地上，也放松了警惕。
一名蒙面人说出了实情，“我只能告诉你，是你们秦家人，其他的我不能说的太多。能说的我已经说了，准备好了吗？希望你在地下，不要找我们麻烦！”
说完，向着其他人使了一个眼色，随后，六七个蒙面人都举起了武器，向着柳嫣然砍了下去……

In a luxurious manor, in a luxurious villa. A mother and son are being surrounded and killed by masked men...
"Jun'er... Jun'er... you must listen to Uncle Shui from now on. Ah Shui, take Jun'er away quickly, as far away as possible! Find his father when you have the chance."
"Miss, don't worry, I will protect the young master." The servant Qin Yuyu said quickly while holding the three-year-old Qin Yanjun in his left hand and holding a sword in his right hand.
"Dad...Dad...where are you? Come and save mom, ah...ah..."
The child's cry attracted the attention of the killer. Qin Yuyu could only rush out of the manor with the child in his arms, with the killer chasing after him...
As the head mother of the family, Liu Yanran ordered her servant Qin Yuu to take him away in order to protect her only son.
He was surrounded by several masked men, and he felt a little resentful in his heart: "Feixiong, where have you been? Your son is about to be killed, and you haven't come back yet?"
"Tell me, who are you? Why do you want to assassinate us two?"
"Hahaha, don't worry, your man will never come back."
"Perhaps, you are no longer alive at this time, so you'd better not think too much, lest you become more desperate." The masked man said arrogantly.
At this time, Liu Yanran felt desperate and felt cruel in her heart.
"In this case, you go and die! Damn it, I'm going to cut you into pieces."
Suddenly, Liu Yanran picked up a sword from nowhere and rushed left and right, the sword shadow flying, and the masked man felt the pressure.
"Brothers, the sponsor said that this person must die, and the child who escaped must not hold anything back. Work harder, otherwise someone will come soon. If you fail to complete the task, you will be punished if you go back."
"Hahahaha, brothers, come on, try to finish it as soon as possible."
The masked men were very rampant. In addition to the four or five masked men who chased them out, there were six or seven people in the villa laughing.
Liu Yanran was extremely angry. She raised the long sword in her hand and flew towards the masked man angrily.
However, after all, she was just a mother with a child, and she usually neglected to practice. Under the attack of six or seven people, she was soon at a disadvantage.
Finally, after killing two more people, he finally lost strength and half-knelt on the ground, holding a sword in one hand.
"You bitch, you actually killed two of us. You must die today. Otherwise, how can you explain to them?"
"Boss, hurry up! Accidents may happen as time goes by."
Liu Yanran, who was half-kneeling on the ground, knew that she might not survive today, so she asked.
"How many of you? You are covering your face. I don't care about this. For the sake of my imminent death, let me die and tell me who is behind the scenes?"
"Haha! Do you still want to be a sensible person? I can tell you, but you can't resist after I say it."
Liu Yanran threw the sword in front of her, showing her 'sincerity'!
When several masked men saw Liu Yanran dropping her sword on the ground, they also relaxed their vigilance.
A masked man told the truth, "I can only tell you that it's your Qin family. I can't say much else. I've said what I can. Are you ready? I hope you are underground and don't cause trouble for us!"
After saying that, he winked at the others, and then six or seven masked men raised their weapons and slashed at Liu Yanran...
